# x tan(x): IEEE 754 binary64 bits, correctly rounded (mpmath, 2400 bits)
# The inputs are the x column of sin_cos64_reference.txt, so the same
# reduction branches are covered: small, medium, every reduction-branch
# threshold, near multiples of pi/2, the input closest to a multiple of pi/2
# in every third binade, and log-uniform values up to f64::MAX.
# Reproduce with:
#   python3 -c 'import mpmath,struct; mpmath.mp.prec=2400
#   f=lambda h: struct.unpack("<d", struct.pack("<Q", h))[0]
#   b=lambda v: struct.unpack("<Q", struct.pack("<d", v))[0]
#   [print("%016x %016x" % (h, b(float(mpmath.tan(mpmath.mpf(f(h)))))))
#    for h in (int(l.split()[0],16) for l in open("tests/data/sin_cos64_reference.txt")
#              if not l.startswith("#") and l.strip())]'
# Not produced by any libm: a platform libm is up to 1.0e5 ulp off here
# (glibc at x = 0x6404c96c11134d36) and is not a correctness reference.
